name: Fit Picture
description: Fits the second input into the frame of the first, like the screen modes of slideshow tools: center, crop, stretch, or centered over a blurred copy. The first input gives the size, and shows through wherever the picture and `color` are transparent.

inputs.name: canvas
inputs.description: Gives the output size and frame rate; shows through a transparent background

params.name: mode
params.description: 0 center, 1 crop to fill, 2 stretch, 3 center over a blurred stretched copy

params.name: upscale
params.description: Let center and blur modes enlarge pictures smaller than the frame

params.name: blur
params.description: Blur radius of the background in mode 3, relative to the frame height

params.name: color
params.description: Background behind the picture in modes 0 to 2 (transparent shows the first input); mode 3 uses the blurred copy
